data.one_liner: Flutter date picker library that renders a calendar as a horizontal timeline.
data.what_it_does: Provides a horizontal timeline widget for selecting dates, weeks, or months. Supports single, multiple, and range selection modes, customizable appearance, localized day and month names, and a controller for programmatic scrolling and selection management.
use_when: You need a horizontal calendar strip or date timeline UI
Users need to select single dates, multiple dates, or a date range visually
You want support for custom granularities like week or month tiles
avoid_when: You need a traditional grid-style popup or dropdown calendar picker
You require complex event indicators or scheduling capabilities on the calendar
strengths: Supports multiple selection modes including single, multiple, and range
Offers week and month granularities alongside daily views
Includes a DatePickerController for programmatic navigation and selection
weaknesses: Limited to a horizontal timeline layout rather than full grid calendars

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a standard vertical grid-based calendar date picker instead of a horizontal timeline.
